_description: Material Design 3 audit batch template. Add checks for each screen/component, then run: python3 scripts/md3_checker.py batch this_file.json
_scoring: Starts at 100, -10 per violation. 90-100=ship, 70-80=fix before release, <70=systematic rework.

_check_types.contrast: WCAG contrast check. Requires fg (foreground hex), bg (background hex). Optional: large_text (bool, defaults false).
_check_types.touch-target: 48dp minimum touch target. Requires w (width), h (height) in dp.
_check_types.component: MD3 component spec validation. Requires element (component name), property (spec property), actual (measured value in dp).
